datasets.label: London Ambulance Service
datasets.description: The FalCom paper's case study at its locked capacity-block calibration: 4,994 LSOAs of the LAS catchment, annual attended incidents as demand, 66 real stations among 1,831 candidates (CDBA-repaired), w_unit=10,887, ε=0.15, c¹∈[1,3]. Sampling chain (always_accept), 1,000 steps, with per-step hierarchy (super-district boundaries), facility centers, and ensemble overlays.

datasets.label: 20 × 20 grid (tree animation)
datasets.description: 400-node synthetic grid with full spanning-tree substep recording: switch to Detailed view to watch each proposal's four phases — supergraph partition, superdistrict selection, capacitated tree cuts with ψ scores, facility assignment, accept/reject. Ensemble overlays included.
